title: Rewinding an auxiliary tape
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, let $P$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ allowed positions, and let $b$ be a Boolean vector of length equal to the number of selector bits for $M$. Let $w$ be a Boolean word, let $\tau_0,\tau_1:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ be tape contents, and let $z_0,z_1\in\mathbb{Z}$. For every $j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $j\le |w|$, running the tabulating machine for $j+1$ steps from the configuration whose state is the output-rewind state with vector $b$, whose input-head position is $P$, whose first two auxiliary tapes and head positions are $(\tau_0,z_0)$ and $(\tau_1,z_1)$, and whose third auxiliary tape stores $w$ from cell zero with head at $j-1$, yields the configuration with state the decode state carrying $b$, the initial state of $M$, an empty output register, and tag true. The input-head position, all tape contents, the first two auxiliary head positions, and the empty output are unchanged; the third auxiliary head is at cell zero.
